Pull requests are by invitation only. Please read the [contribution policy](https://github.com/awpri/hunter-gatherer/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Maintainer invitation

Link the issue or discussion where the maintainer invited this pull request.

## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

Explain the checks you ran and any relevant limitations. Include screenshots for visible UI changes when useful.

## Packaging or migration notes

Mention added public-export files, configuration changes or compatibility effects. Delete this section if it does not apply.
